observations: Own bend scan (independent of route_check): 39 two-track nodes with a branch angle below 135 deg (35 at 90 deg, 4 at 45 deg); every one sits in a same-net pad or via whose copper covers the inner corner / wedge apex (e.g. 3V3 B.Cu (21.82,52.15) in C14.1, CAM_5V B.Cu (38.6,52.75) in J9.1); no free 90 deg or acute bend, consistent with right_angle 0.

No off-angle segment (all 1059 headings within 0.01 deg of a multiple of 45 deg), no zero-length segment, no arc, no dangling track end; six track ends terminate on another segment's centreline (clean T joints: the four port-clamp taps at x 35.75, VBUS B.Cu (11.3,30.0), BUZZ_G B.Cu (20.5,58.70)).
BUZZ_G T at (20.5,58.70) 0.020 mm before the chamfer start (20.5,58.72): already a round 24 observation; nothing new.

route_check info categories (pad_end_offcentre 70, short_layer_hop 18, power_via_no_gnd 28, extra_bends 14, u_turn 5, ...) and the 5 unrecorded noncritical leftovers match the records' count and are informational under AUD-10.

Detour total with zero-length nets included is 117 nets, 1500.8 / 1236.8 mm, 1.213x; the record's 116 nets / 1236.6 mm / 1.214x is the r21 method (zero-length nets excluded); method difference already reconciled in rounds 32/33.
J420 / J9 clamp centre distance 3.064 mm, quoted as part of 'J410 / J420 3.1-3.4 mm': correct rounding.

PYRO1_OUT's layer-change via (11.63,55.1) has no In2 copper within 0.55 mm (S-8 GND keep-out void) while R10_VALIDATION section 6 groups it with vias 'over In2 GND'; the void lies inside the In2 GND plane, so this is loose wording, not a false statement.
